title: Store
body:
Sponsored giveaways, ads, custom roles and donations.

Pick something below for details, then open a ticket to buy or claim it.

options.label: Sponsored Giveaway
options.description: We host and push your giveaway
options.title: Sponsored Giveaway
options.content:
We run your giveaway in our server and put it in front of our members.

You get a hosted giveaway with your prize and branding, a ping to our giveaway role, and we handle winner selection and delivery.

Open a ticket with your prize and how long you want it to run.

options.label: Advertisement
options.title: Advertisement
options.content:
Your server or service posted to our members.

Includes your banner and invite, an optional ping, and placement for an agreed run.

Have your copy and banner ready when you open the ticket. We'll tell you if anything breaks Discord's rules before it goes up.

options.label: Custom Role
options.title: Custom Role
options.content:
A role with the name and colour you pick, sitting above standard member roles. Rename it whenever.

Nothing offensive, and nothing that looks like a staff role. We'll ask you to change it if it does.

options.label: Donate
options.title: Donate
options.content:
Donations cover hosting and go to the designers.

Donors get a supporter role. There's no obligation and nothing is locked behind it, but it does genuinely help.

Open a ticket if you want to.
